# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old (at time of initial proposal)
- **Gender:** Male
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

He is a large, overweight young man with a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

Barney is quiet, bashful, and emotionless, possessing very little capacity for chatter or laughter. He is an agonizingly awkward conversationalist who smirks and laughs softly, rarely managing to formulate a response until after the moment has passed. Despite his extreme shyness, he is hardworking, reliable, free of negative vices, and kind-hearted.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## Traits

- Large and overweight
- Emotionless
- Bashful and shy  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
- Hardworking  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>
- Reliable  <sub>[v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Goals

- To marry Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## History

Barney harbored a vast admiration for Nell Harcourt and felt immense pride driving her to a concert at Pale Sands in his buggy. Because he lacked conversation skills, Nell spent much of the ride chatting behind her back to the other girls, while Barney smirked and chuckled quietly. Later, after his father deeded him the upper farm in his own name, Barney sought to take Nell as his wife. Due to his extreme bashfulness, he repeatedly harassed his sister Odette until she agreed to propose to Nell on his behalf. Barney offered to wait until Nell finished her college education if necessary, though he preferred a spring wedding before planting; however, Nell firmly rejected the proposal, as she had never considered him in that way.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P29](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0029), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016)_
